comment: Ballistic Dynamics rifles: twist, barrel and the optic's height over the bore.

provenance.twist_in: published: American Rifleman, The Remington M24 Sniper Weapon System (2016): 5R rifling, one turn in 11.25 in, right hand
provenance.barrel_in: published: American Rifleman (2016), 24 in free-floated barrel
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: a 30 mm tube scope in low rings over a Remington 700 action sits about 1.5 to 2 in above the bore

provenance.twist_in: published: SAAMI Z299.4 6.5 Creedmoor drawing, 1 turn in 8 in
provenance.barrel_in: estimated: 24 in, the length Hornady quotes its 6.5 Creedmoor velocities from
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: a 30 mm scope in medium rings, 1.5 to 2 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: published: C.I.P. TDCC .338 Lapua Magnum, twist 254 mm (1 in 10 in)
provenance.barrel_in: estimated: 27 in, typical of .338 LM sniper rifles (AI AWM, Sako TRG-42)
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: a 34 mm scope on a 20 MOA rail, about 2 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: published: C.I.P. TDCC 12.7x99 / .50 BMG, twist 381 mm (1 in 15 in)
provenance.barrel_in: published: Barrett M82A1 / M107, 29 in barrel
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: a large scope over the M107's rail, about 2.5 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: published: M16A2 / M4 barrels are rifled 1 turn in 7 in for the M855
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: an optic on a flat-top AR sits about 2.6 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: published: SAAMI 9 mm Luger, 1 turn in 10 in
provenance.barrel_in: published: Speer quotes 23618GD from a 4 in test barrel
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: iron sights about 0.5 in over the bore of a service pistol

provenance.twist_in: published: .408 CheyTac rifling 1 turn in 13 in (330.2 mm)
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: a large tactical scope on the M200's raised rail, about 2.4 in over the bore
